title: [v0.93.1][defect] Report dashboard JavaScript validation as skipped or failed when Node is missing
notes_risks: A zero exit in the Node-absent branch is acceptable only with an explicit SKIP result that cannot be mistaken for behavioral PASS.
non_goals: No dashboard product change, no live sync work, no v0.95 expansion, no runtime restart, and no unrelated validation refactor.
demo_proof_requirements: Focused local assertions over both dependency branches; no live Runtime, deployment, provider, or broad Rust proof.
validation_plan: Run the focused Node test, run the dashboard validator directly with Node present, run git diff --check, and obtain independent pre-PR review.
target_files_surfaces: adl/tools/test_milestone_dashboard.sh and one focused Node test for its Node-present and Node-absent result contract.
inputs: Issue #1261 and the reviewed Runtime72 dashboard-validation finding.
goal: Make the milestone dashboard validation result truthful when Node is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Node absent cannot report behavioral validation PASS; Node present retains actual syntax, rendering, and escaping assertions; focused tests assert distinct executed and skipped outcomes.
required_outcome: The script distinguishes static-only validation from executed JavaScript syntax, rendering, and escaping assertions, while preserving the existing Node-present checks.
